question: Walk through the stages you'd put in place to turn this into a real, repeatable ML pipeline.
idealAnswer:
A data ingestion stage that pulls fresh data from its source on a schedule, rather than relying on a one-off file the notebook happened to use

A separate, reusable preprocessing and feature engineering stage so training and any future inference apply the exact same transformations

A training stage that's parameterized and reproducible, tracked in version control, rather than re-run manually in a notebook

An evaluation stage with defined metrics and a threshold the new model must clear before promotion, ideally compared against the current production model

A deployment and serving stage, plus a way to roll back to the previous model if something goes wrong

Mentions basic monitoring or logging of the pipeline's health and the model's outputs once live, not just deploying and walking away
